parameters.query:
SELECT TOP 1 pr.RunId, pr.ProjectId, p.Slug, p.Name AS ProjectName, p.Idea
FROM ProjectRuns pr
JOIN Projects p ON p.ProjectId = pr.ProjectId
WHERE pr.Status = 'Pending' AND pr.CurrentStage = 'AIQ-PF-03-ResearchSynthesis'
ORDER BY pr.StartedAt ASC;
UPDATE ProjectRuns SET Status = 'Running' WHERE RunId = '{{ $json.RunId }}';

parameters.command: =cd /opt/aiq/product-factory/repo/projects/{{ $json.Slug }}/research && echo '## MARKET RESEARCH' && cat market-research.md && echo '' && echo '## COMPETITOR ANALYSIS' && cat competitor-analysis.md && echo '' && echo '## USER RESEARCH' && cat user-research.md
